Residential and commercial, Greater Sydney

Hot Water Systems Supplied, Installed and Repaired Across Sydney

We supply the system and we install it, so one licensed team handles the quote, the unit, the fit-off and the old unit removal. If your hot water has failed, we also repair and replace gas, electric, solar and heat pump systems across Sydney.

Call 1300 096 668

Phone answered 24 hours for hot water emergencies.

What do you need today

  • 20+ yearsin hot water across Sydney
  • Licensed teamplumbing and gas work
  • Available 24 hoursfor emergency breakdowns
  • Six major brandssupplied and installed

Hot water brands we supply and install

  • Evoheat

What do you need today

Choose the hot water service you need

Most people arrive here for one of four reasons. Pick the one that matches your situation and we will quote on that work specifically, not on a generic call-out.

Hot Water Installation

You need a new system supplied and fitted, whether that is a first install or an upgrade to a different type.

Installation

Hot Water Repairs

No hot water, lukewarm water, a leaking unit, a pilot light that will not stay on or an error code on the display.

Repairs

Hot Water Replacement

Your current unit has reached the end of its life and you want it swapped over with minimal time without hot water.

Replacement

Servicing & Maintenance

Scheduled servicing to keep a system running properly, including anode and valve checks on storage units.

Servicing

Supply and install, one team

We provide the system and we fit it

Buying a hot water unit from one place and finding a plumber to install it is where most of the delay and cost confusion comes from. We hold stock of gas, electric, heat pump and continuous flow systems, and our own licensed team carries out the installation, so the quote covers the unit, the labour, the fittings and the removal of the old system.

That also means the person recommending the system is the person who has to install it. If a 170 litre gas storage unit will not fit the space you have, or your switchboard will not support an electric upgrade, you find out before you buy rather than on installation day.

Where a repair is the better option, we will say so. Replacing a unit that only needs a new element, thermostat or valve is not something we push.

How installation works

System types

Which type of hot water system suits your property

The right system depends on what is already connected at the property, how many people use hot water and where the unit can physically sit. Here is how the four main types we supply and install compare.

Gas Storage

A tank that keeps water heated and ready. Suits homes already on natural gas with room for an external unit.

Gas systems and installation

Instant Gas & Continuous Flow

Heats water on demand with no tank. Good where space is tight or hot water use is spread through the day.

Continuous flow and installation

Electric Storage

The most common replacement where there is no gas connection. Available in sizes for one bathroom up to larger households.

Electric systems and installation

Heat Pump

Uses ambient air to heat water and usually runs on less electricity than a standard electric tank. Rebates may apply in NSW.

Heat pump systems and installation

Also see solar hot water

How it works

From first call to hot water back on

The same four steps apply whether you are replacing a failed unit or planning an upgrade.

  1. Tell us what is happening

    Call or send an enquiry with your suburb, the type of system you have and what it is doing. Photos of the unit and its data plate help a great deal.

  2. We scope and quote

    We confirm whether the job is a repair, a like-for-like replacement or a change of system type, then quote on the unit, labour and any compliance work required.

  3. We supply and install

    We bring the system, disconnect the old unit, install and commission the new one, and check the tempering valve and relief valve are working as they should.

  4. We clear the site

    The old unit is taken away, the work is tested in front of you, and you get the paperwork and warranty details for the system that was fitted.

Brands we hold and install

Six hot water brands, supplied and fitted by our own team

We carry and install these brands, and we service and repair them as well. If your existing unit is one of these, parts and like-for-like replacements are straightforward.

  • RheemGas, electric, heat pump
  • RinnaiContinuous flow, storage
  • DuxGas, electric, heat pump
  • AquamaxStainless steel storage
  • ThermannGas, electric, heat pump
  • EvoheatHeat pump specialists

Why Sydney households and businesses call us

Reasons Sydney homes and businesses choose our hot water team

  • Hot water is all we do

    Over twenty years working on gas, electric, solar and heat pump systems means fault diagnosis is quicker and recommendations are based on what actually fails in these units.

  • One team from quote to commissioning

    You are not managing a supplier and an installer separately. The unit, the fit-off, the removal and the compliance checks sit with us.

  • Reachable when a system fails

    Hot water tends to fail at the worst time. Our phone line is attended 24 hours so an emergency breakdown can be triaged rather than left until the next business day.

  • Residential and commercial work

    We work on single homes, apartments, and commercial sites where hot water loss interrupts trading. Commercial scope is quoted separately.

Commercial and strata

Hot water for businesses, strata and property managers

A failed commercial system can stop a kitchen, a salon, a gym or a childcare centre from trading. We install, service and repair larger plant and multi-unit systems, and can work with building managers on access and scheduling.

Where we are typically called

  • Hospitality and food premises that cannot trade without compliant hot water
  • Apartment buildings and strata-managed complexes with shared or individual units
  • Gyms, salons, childcare and medical rooms with high or peak-time demand
  • Offices, warehouses and industrial sites needing straightforward replacement

What a commercial enquiry usually covers

  • Assessment of the existing plant and whether repair or replacement is sensible
  • Sizing for the actual demand rather than the size that happens to be there now
  • Access, isolation and timing so downtime lands when it hurts least
  • Documentation for the building owner, managing agent or tenant

Commercial hot water systems

Areas we serve

Hot water service across Sydney and Greater Sydney

We work across the Sydney metropolitan area from our base at Lidcombe. Choose the region closest to you to see coverage and the suburbs we attend.

  • Western Sydney
  • Inner West
  • Eastern Suburbs
  • The Hills District
  • Sutherland Shire
  • Northern Beaches
  • Parramatta
  • All Sydney areas

If your suburb is not listed, call us anyway. Coverage depends on the job and the day, and we would rather tell you straight away than have you wait.

What affects the price

What we need to know before quoting your hot water job

Hot water quotes vary for real reasons, not arbitrary ones. These are the factors that change the figure, and the ones we ask about first.

Factors that change a hot water quote
FactorWhy it mattersWhat helps us quote faster
System type and sizeA continuous flow unit, a storage tank and a heat pump are different units with different installation requirements.The brand, model and capacity from the data plate on your current unit.
Like for like, or a change of typeSwapping electric for heat pump, or storage for continuous flow, can involve electrical, gas or drainage changes.Tell us if you want to stay with the same type or are considering a change.
Location of the unitA unit in a tight side passage, on a roof, or up stairs takes longer and may need extra access equipment.A photo of the unit and the space around it.
Condition of existing connectionsOld valves, perished flexible connections or non-compliant tempering valves usually need replacing at the same time.The approximate age of the system, if you know it.
Repair or replaceAn element, thermostat or valve fault is a repair. A corroded or leaking tank is not worth repairing.What the unit is actually doing, including any error code shown.
Rebates and incentivesNSW energy programs can apply to some efficient systems and change what the upgrade costs you.Ask us whether the system you are considering is eligible.

Common questions

Hot water questions we are asked most

We supply it. We hold gas, electric, heat pump and continuous flow systems from Rheem, Rinnai, Dux, Aquamax, Thermann and Evoheat, and our licensed team installs what we supply. You are welcome to discuss a unit you already own, but the usual arrangement is one quote covering the system and the installation together.

Book the repair enquiry and describe the symptoms. Many faults are an element, thermostat, valve or ignition problem and are worth repairing. A tank that is leaking from the body, or a unit well past its expected life, is usually better replaced. We will tell you which situation you are in before any work is committed.

Often yes, and it is one of the more common upgrades we are asked about. Changing type depends on what is available at the property, such as a gas connection for a gas system, suitable outdoor space and airflow for a heat pump, or switchboard capacity for an electric upgrade. We check those things at quoting stage rather than on the day.

Yes. We install, service and repair hot water for businesses and multi-unit buildings as well as houses. Commercial work is scoped and quoted separately because access, sizing, isolation and timing all affect the job. Use the enquiry form and tell us the property type so it reaches the right person.

Your suburb, the brand and model from the data plate on the unit, roughly how old it is, and what it is doing now. If you can send a photo of the unit and the space around it, that usually removes a round of questions and lets us quote more accurately the first time.

Request a quote

Tell us about your hot water job

Send the details and we will come back with the next step, whether that is a repair booking, a replacement quote or advice on which system suits the property. If your hot water is out right now, calling is faster.

Call 1300 096 668

@font-face{font-family:"Jost";font-style:normal;font-weight:400 700;font-display:swap;src:url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format("woff2")}

:root{
  --navy:#20386e; --navy-900:#0d1426; --navy-800:#121c33; --navy-700:#1a2b55;
  --navy-600:#2b4a8c; --navy-400:#5f7cb8; --navy-300:#93a8d2; --navy-50:#eef2f9;

  --line:#e5e9f1; --line-2:#ccd4e2; --line-dark:rgba(255,255,255,.14);
  --paper:#ffffff; --paper-2:#f5f7fb; --paper-3:#eef2f8;
  --d-ink:#ffffff; --d-body:#c4d0e6; --d-muted:#8e9cba;
  --r-xs:6px; --r-sm:10px; --r:16px; --r-card:22px; --r-lg:32px; --r-xl:46px; --r-pill:999px;
  --sh-1:0 2px 4px rgba(13,20,38,.04);
  --sh-2:0 18px 44px -20px rgba(13,20,38,.3);
  --sh-3:0 40px 90px -34px rgba(13,20,38,.5);
  --gut:clamp(18px,4.4vw,52px);

  --t:.24s; --t-slow:.55s; --ease:cubic-bezier(.4,.16,.2,1);
}
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box}
html{-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%;scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{margin:0;background:var(--paper);color:var(--body);font-family:var(--ff-body);font-size:17px;line-height:1.72;overflow-x:hidden;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}

p{margin:0 0 1.1em}

img{max-width:100%;height:auto;display:block}
ul{margin:0 0 1.1em;padding-left:1.15em}
li{margin-bottom:.5em}

section[id]{scroll-margin-top:104px}

/* ---------- eyebrow + section heads ---------- */
.eyebrow{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.6em;font-family:var(--ff-head);font-size:.8rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--navy);margin:0 0 1.05rem}
.eyebrow::before{content:"";width:22px;height:22px;flex:none;border-radius:50%;background:var(--red);
  -webkit-mask:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%,transparent 0 3.6px,#000 3.6px);
  mask:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%,transparent 0 3.6px,#000 3.6px);
  box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 99px var(--red)}
.sec-head{margin-bottom:clamp(34px,4vw,62px);max-width:74ch}

.sec-head.split h2{margin-bottom:0}
.sec-head.split .eyebrow{grid-column:1/-1}
.sec-head.split .lede{margin:0;padding-bottom:.45rem}
.sec-head.center{margin-inline:auto;text-align:center;max-width:62ch}
.sec-head.center .eyebrow{justify-content:center}
.sec-head.center .lede{margin-inline:auto}

/* ---------- buttons ---------- */
.btn{position:relative;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:.7em;font-family:var(--ff-head);font-weight:600;font-size:.98rem;line-height:1.2;letter-spacing:.015em;padding:14px 22px 14px 28px;border-radius:var(--r-pill);border:1.5px solid transparent;cursor:pointer;text-decoration:none;min-height:58px;overflow:hidden;isolation:isolate;transition:background-color var(--t) var(--ease),border-color var(--t) var(--ease),color var(--t) var(--ease),transform var(--t) var(--ease),box-shadow var(--t) var(--ease)}
.btn .ic{position:relative;z-index:1}
.btn>span{position:relative;z-index:1}
.btn .bdg{position:relative;z-index:1;width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;flex:none;margin-left:.1em;transition:transform var(--t) var(--ease),background-color var(--t) var(--ease),color var(--t) var(--ease)}
.btn .bdg svg{width:13px;height:13px;fill:currentColor}

.btn-primary{background:var(--red);color:#fff;border-color:var(--red);box-shadow:0 12px 26px -12px rgba(203,66,54,.85)}

.btn-navy .bdg{background:#fff;color:var(--navy)}
.btn-navy:hover{background:var(--navy-700);border-color:var(--navy-700);color:#fff;transform:translateY(-2px)}
.btn-ghost{background:transparent;color:var(--navy);border-color:var(--line-2)}
.btn-ghost .bdg{background:var(--navy-50);color:var(--navy)}
.btn-ghost:hover{border-color:var(--navy);background:var(--navy-50);color:var(--navy)}
.btn-onDark{background:transparent;color:#fff;border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.42)}
.btn-onDark .bdg{background:rgba(255,255,255,.16);color:#fff}
.btn-onDark:hover{background:#fff;color:var(--navy-900);border-color:#fff;transform:translateY(-2px)}
.btn-onDark:hover .bdg{background:var(--navy-900);color:#fff}
.btn-sm{padding:10px 16px 10px 20px;font-size:.88rem;min-height:46px;gap:.5em}

/* ---------- hero: full-bleed media, overlay, display type ---------- */
.hero{position:relative;background:var(--navy-900);color:var(--d-body);--hdr-bar:111px;margin-top:calc(var(--hdr-bar) * -1);padding-top:var(--hdr-bar);isolation:isolate}

.hero .media::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:1;pointer-events:none;background:
  linear-gradient(94deg,rgba(10,16,30,.95) 0%,rgba(10,16,30,.88) 36%,rgba(10,16,30,.6) 62%,rgba(10,16,30,.5) 100%),

/* ============================================================
   v6: live ticker bar, animated call button, shining headline
   ============================================================ */

/* ---------- top ticker bar ---------- */
.utility{background:#0a1020;overflow:hidden}
.utility .wrap{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:clamp(14px,2vw,26px);padding-block:9px;max-width:none;
  padding-inline:clamp(14px,3vw,34px)}
.live-pill{position:relative;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.55em;flex:none;margin:0;
  font-family:var(--ff-head);font-weight:700;font-size:.74rem;letter-spacing:.13em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:#7ef0a6;background:rgba(34,197,94,.14);border:1px solid rgba(34,197,94,.42);
  border-radius:var(--r-pill);padding:7px 15px 7px 13px;white-space:nowrap;
  animation:pill-breathe 3s var(--ease) infinite}
@keyframes pill-breathe{
  0%,100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(34,197,94,.34);border-color:rgba(34,197,94,.42)}
  50%{box-shadow:0 0 0 7px rgba(34,197,94,0);border-color:rgba(34,197,94,.8)}
}
.live-dot{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:#2ee06a;flex:none;position:relative;
  box-shadow:0 0 9px rgba(46,224,106,.95)}
.live-dot::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:-5px;border-radius:50%;border:1.5px solid rgba(46,224,106,.75);
  animation:dot-ping 2.1s var(--ease) infinite}
@keyframes dot-ping{0%{transform:scale(.55);opacity:1}75%,100%{transform:scale(1.5);opacity:0}}
.ticker{position:relative;flex:1 1 auto;min-width:0;overflow:hidden;
  -webkit-mask:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent 0,#000 7%,#000 93%,transparent 100%);
  mask:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent 0,#000 7%,#000 93%,transparent 100%)}
.ticker-track{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:0;width:max-content;animation:tick-roll 46s linear infinite}
.ticker-track span{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;white-space:nowrap;font-size:.8rem;color:#c3d1ea;
  padding:0 clamp(18px,2vw,30px)}
.ticker-track span::after{content:"";width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--red);
  margin-left:clamp(18px,2vw,30px);flex:none}
@keyframes tick-roll{from{transform:translateX(0)}to{transform:translateX(-50%)}}
.utility:hover .ticker-track{animation-play-state:paused}
@media (max-width:860px){
  .utility .wrap{gap:12px;padding-block:7px}
  .live-pill{font-size:.66rem;letter-spacing:.1em;padding:6px 12px 6px 10px}
  .ticker-track span{font-size:.74rem}
}
@media (max-width:420px){
  .ticker{display:none}
  .utility .wrap{justify-content:center}
}

/* ---------- animated call button: hot water filling, steam rising ---------- */
.callbtn{position:relative;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;isolation:isolate;overflow:hidden;
  border-radius:var(--r-pill);padding:0;text-decoration:none;flex:none;min-height:54px;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,#16254a 0%,#0d1730 100%);
  border:1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,.22);
  box-shadow:0 10px 26px -12px rgba(0,0,0,.8),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.14);
  transition:transform var(--t) var(--ease),border-color var(--t) var(--ease),box-shadow var(--t) var(--ease)}
.site-header.is-stuck .callbtn,.site-header.menu-open .callbtn{border-color:rgba(32,56,110,.26)}
.callbtn-liquid{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;height:44%;z-index:0;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(214,78,65,.97) 0%,#9c2f26 100%);
  animation:liquid-rise 5.2s var(--ease) infinite}
.callbtn-liquid::before,.callbtn-liquid::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:-52%;right:-52%;top:-7px;height:14px;
  background:radial-gradient(60% 115% at 50% 100%,#cb4236 0 64%,transparent 66%);
  background-size:26px 14px;background-repeat:repeat-x}
.callbtn-liquid::before{animation:wave-a 2.6s linear infinite}
.callbtn-liquid::after{top:-4px;opacity:.6;animation:wave-b 3.8s linear infinite}
@keyframes liquid-rise{0%,100%{height:38%}46%{height:54%}70%{height:46%}}
@keyframes wave-a{from{transform:translateX(0)}to{transform:translateX(26px)}}
@keyframes wave-b{from{transform:translateX(0)}to{transform:translateX(-26px)}}
.callbtn-liquid::marker{content:""}
.callbtn-boil{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;height:46%;z-index:1;pointer-events:none;overflow:hidden}
.callbtn-boil i{position:absolute;bottom:-6px;width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:50%;
  background:radial-gradient(circle at 34% 30%,rgba(255,255,255,.95),rgba(255,214,206,.5) 60%,rgba(255,255,255,0) 72%);
  opacity:0;animation:boil 2.4s linear infinite}
.callbtn-boil i:nth-child(1){left:14%;animation-delay:0s}
.callbtn-boil i:nth-child(2){left:31%;width:4px;height:4px;animation-delay:.5s;animation-duration:2.1s}
.callbtn-boil i:nth-child(3){left:49%;width:6px;height:6px;animation-delay:1s;animation-duration:2.7s}
.callbtn-boil i:nth-child(4){left:66%;width:4px;height:4px;animation-delay:1.5s;animation-duration:2.2s}
.callbtn-boil i:nth-child(5){left:82%;animation-delay:1.9s;animation-duration:2.5s}
@keyframes boil{
  0%{opacity:0;transform:translateY(0) scale(.5)}
  18%{opacity:.95}
  78%{opacity:.7}
  100%{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-32px) scale(1.25)}
}
.callbtn-steam{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:4;pointer-events:none;overflow:hidden}
.callbtn-steam i{position:absolute;bottom:34%;width:16px;height:16px;border-radius:50%;
  background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,255,255,.8),rgba(255,236,232,.3) 48%,rgba(255,255,255,0) 72%);
  filter:blur(4.5px);opacity:0;animation:steam 4.2s var(--ease) infinite}
.callbtn-steam i:nth-child(1){left:12%;animation-delay:0s}
.callbtn-steam i:nth-child(2){left:38%;width:20px;height:20px;animation-delay:1.4s;animation-duration:4.8s}
.callbtn-steam i:nth-child(3){left:64%;width:18px;height:18px;animation-delay:2.8s;animation-duration:4.4s}
.callbtn-steam i:nth-child(4){left:85%;width:14px;height:14px;animation-delay:2s;animation-duration:5s}
@keyframes steam{
  0%{opacity:0;transform:translateY(10px) scale(.45)}
  28%{opacity:.9}
  65%{opacity:.55;transform:translateY(-10px) scale(1.5) translateX(3px)}
  100%{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-26px) scale(2.3) translateX(-2px)}
}
.callbtn-face{position:relative;z-index:5;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.7em;padding:8px 20px 8px 9px}
.callbtn-ring{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;flex:none;color:#fff;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.18);border:1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,.4);
  animation:ring-shake 4s var(--ease) infinite}
.callbtn-ring .ic{width:17px;height:17px}
@keyframes ring-shake{
  0%,58%,100%{transform:rotate(0)}
  62%{transform:rotate(-16deg)}66%{transform:rotate(14deg)}
  70%{transform:rotate(-11deg)}74%{transform:rotate(9deg)}78%{transform:rotate(0)}
}
.callbtn-txt{display:flex;flex-direction:column;line-height:1.1;font-family:var(--ff-head);font-weight:700;
  font-size:1.03rem;color:#fff;letter-spacing:.01em;white-space:nowrap}
.callbtn-txt small{font-family:var(--ff-body);font-weight:600;font-size:.63rem;letter-spacing:.11em;
  text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(255,255,255,.72);margin-bottom:3px}
.callbtn:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.55);
  box-shadow:0 16px 34px -12px rgba(203,66,54,.85),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.2)}
.callbtn:hover .callbtn-liquid{animation-duration:2.2s}
.callbtn:active{transform:translateY(0)}
@media (max-width:1399px){
  .callbtn-txt{font-size:.95rem}
  .callbtn-face{padding:7px 16px 7px 8px}
  .callbtn-ring{width:34px;height:34px}
}

/* ---------- shining headline phrase ---------- */
.shine{position:relative;display:inline-block;
  background:linear-gradient(100deg,#ffffff 0%,#ffffff 36%,#ffd9d3 44%,#ffffff 52%,#ffffff 100%);
  background-size:280% 100%;
  -webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;
  animation:shine-sweep 5.5s var(--ease) infinite}
@keyframes shine-sweep{0%{background-position:160% 0}55%,100%{background-position:-60% 0}}
.shine::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:-6%;right:-6%;bottom:-.1em;height:.1em;border-radius:3px;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,var(--red) 22%,#ff8f82 50%,var(--red) 78%,transparent);
  opacity:.9;animation:shine-bar 5.5s var(--ease) infinite}
@keyframes shine-bar{0%,20%{transform:scaleX(0);opacity:0}45%{transform:scaleX(1);opacity:.95}85%,100%{transform:scaleX(1);opacity:.5}}

/* ---------- louder CTAs ---------- */
.btn-primary{position:relative}

  background-size:260% 100%;animation:btn-sheen 3.6s var(--ease) infinite}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
  .ticker-track,.live-pill,.live-dot::after,.callbtn-liquid,.callbtn-liquid::before,.callbtn-liquid::after,
